title: uimage overlay
description: A lightweight client-side mod for Fabric that allows you to display custom images and animated GIFs as HUD overlays.
body:
🖼️ uimage
uimage is a versatile Fabric mod designed for players, creators, and streamers who want to customize their screen with personal images or GIFs. Whether it's a stream goal, a cute pet, or a funny meme, uimage brings them into your Minecraft HUD!

✨ Key Features:
Overlay Support: Add PNG, JPG, and Animated GIFs directly from your computer.

Full Customization:

Positioning: Change X and Y coordinates with pixel precision.

Resizing: Scale your images to any size.

Rotation: Rotate images in degrees.

Transparency: Set the alpha level (0-100%) for a ghost-like effect.

GIF Control: Adjust the animation speed (frame delay).

Persistence: All your overlays are saved automatically in the config file.

Localization: Supports English and Russian.

⌨️ How to use:
Press the "[" (Left Bracket) key to open the manager.

Click [+] Add Image and select your file.

Select the image from the list and tweak the settings on the right!
